nodes.asset_description: A gold-colored square with a stylized, curved, interlocking design is centered on a black background. The design is textured and appears slightly rough or speckled.
A horizontal pink bar is centered on a black background. The bar is solid and uniform in color, with no visible texture or pattern.
A blue, wavy, three-dimensional shape resembling a stylized letter "M" sits on a black background. A yellow, rectangular block is positioned to the right of the blue shape, partially overlapping it.
A pinkish-red, textured arch shape with a rounded top and a smaller, rounded base is centered on a black background. A small blue area is visible at the bottom left corner of the arch.
A stylized eye icon is centered on a black background. The eye is light beige with darker speckles and features two circular pupils surrounded by radiating lines.
